proof_summary: Let \(H\) be binary entropy and choose \(x_*\in(1/2,1)\) with \(H(x_*)=x_*\log 2=:c\); splitting according to whether \(k/n\le x_*\) and using the bounds from \(2^k\) and \(\binom nk\) shows every summand is at most \(e^{cn}\), hence the whole sum is at most \(n e^{cn}\). For \(k=\lfloor x_*n\rfloor+1\), entropy monotonicity gives \(\binom nk<2^k\), so this residue equals \(\binom nk\), while the binomial theorem gives \(\binom nk\ge e^{nH(k/n)}/(n+1)\); since \(k/n\to x_*\), taking logarithms and squeezing yields the limit \(e^c\).
